# healthchecksio_resume (Action)

Resumes a paused check. If the check is not paused, the action does nothing. Needs a read-write API key.

## Example Usage

```terraform
action "healthchecksio_resume" "maintenance" {
  config {
    check_id = healthchecksio_check.backup.id
  }
}

# To start the action from the CLI: terraform apply -invoke=action.healthchecksio_resume.maintenance
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `check_id` (String) The check: its unique_key (the `id` of `healthchecksio_check`) or its UUID.
